trigger: Request to a secured route with header x-forwarded-client-cert containing URI=spiffe://cluster.local/ns/gateway-example/
exploit_path: Edge gateway is exposed directly (NodePort, no mesh sidecar sets or strips XFCC); an unauthenticated client forges the header, isIntraNamespaceRequest() returns true and filter() returns chain.filter(exchange) before any configured Authenticator runs, so the request reaches the backend via BasicAuthRelayGlobalFilter without credentials. Helper method at lines 81-84.
notes: No Maven/compatible JDK on the build host (Spring Boot 2.1.7 + Lombok 1.18.8 need Java 12); verified by review. Existing AuthenticationGlobalFilterTest sends no XFCC header so the clean path is unchanged. CWE-290/CWE-287.

trigger: Any request carrying an X-Forwarded-For header
exploit_path: Edge is NodePort-exposed with no trusted proxy that sets or strips X-Forwarded-For; the client sends a fresh random value per request, resolveClientKey() returns it, every request gets its own window bucket and the limiter never trips, so credential guessing against AuthenticationGlobalFilter runs unbounded.
notes: Fluid F115 (security controls bypass or absence: rate limiting). CWE-348/CWE-307. Clean parent adds the limiter keyed on the socket remote address; existing RateLimitGlobalFilterTest sends no XFF so it still passes. Branch is cumulative: parent also contains SGE-001.
